stem: A store sells two types of computer, laptops and tablets. The number of laptops sold per hour is modelled by a random variable with distribution $\text{Po}(0.9)$. The number of tablets sold per hour is modelled by an independent random variable with distribution $\text{Po}(1.5)$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that, during a randomly chosen hour, the total number of laptops and tablets sold in the store is less than 4.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: The manager claims that on sunny Saturdays fewer laptops than usual are sold. In order to test this claim, an employee notes the number of laptops sold during a 4-hour period on a randomly chosen sunny Saturday. In fact only 1 laptop is sold during this period. Test the manager’s claim at the 10% significance level.
